name: Demucs API
description: A REST API for Demucs source separation with fast-priority jobs, scheduled nightly HQ upgrades, signed webhooks, optional R2 output, and CPU/GPU backend selection.
notes: CPU is the default compute backend; CUDA and Intel XPU are optional and verified inside the LXC.
The default model is htdemucs and can be pre-downloaded during installation.
Nightly HQ upgrades default to htdemucs_ft during the configured processing window.
The API key is stored at /etc/demucs-api/api-key.
Run update inside the LXC to update the application from GitHub.
